item.title: Kanye West Seeks Forgiveness from the Black Community in Wall Street Journal Apology
item.description: Ye, the artist formerly known as Kanye West, used a full-page paid advertisement in The Wall Street Journal to directly address the Black community

item.title: Texas Black Man Exonerated Nearly 70 Years After Execution in Case Marked by Racial Bias
item.description: Nearly 70 years after a Texas Black man was executed in a case that prosecutors now say was based on false evidence and was riddled with racial bias

item.title: Singing Contest in Rio Prison Provides Creative Outlet for Women Behind Bars
item.description: A group of Brazilian women behind bars applied makeup, donned gowns and competed in a singing contest held on Friday in a Rio de Janeiro prison

item.title: Coalition Calls for Halt to Wage Garnishment on Defaulted Student Loans
item.description: A coalition of advocates is urging the Education Department to stop wage garnishment for nearly 9 million borrowers in default.

item.title: Minnesotans Are Afraid to Access Healthcare Amid Massive ICE Surge
item.description: Two American citizens residing in Minnesota were fatally shot by ICE agents this month amid an uptick of immigration enforcement known as “Operation Metro Surge.”

item.title: Three Journalists-Turned-Legislators Weigh in on CalMatters “Real-or-Fake-Handbag” Controversy
item.description: Three California lawmakers, all trained and experienced journalists, weighed in on a political and media controversy sparked after a CalMatters reporter questioned whether the Louis Vuitton bag Assemblymember Tina McKinnor (D–Inglewood) was carrying at a public event was “real or fake.”

item.title: 16th Annual MLK Community Parade & Celebration Honors Dr. King
item.description: A fun-filled parade was held Saturday, January 24thwith special performances and speakers, live music entertainment.

item.title: Ruby Wheeler Ford, Ninety-five and Fabulous
item.description: On the 22nd of January family and friends of Ruby Wheeler Ford got together at the Sweetwater Women's Club for a very special celebration-appreciation party.

item.title: San Diego Residents Can Apply for Trash and Recycling Fee Assistance
item.description: Starting Thursday, Jan. 22, City of San Diego Environmental Services Department (ESD) customers can apply for financial assistance to help cover annual trash and recycling fees.
